rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound with aṣṭa, qualifying cakraṃ
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, indicating presence of a central pericarp

items.question: What are the defining characteristics of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified in sequence.
It is described as royal in nature.
It possesses eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal, eight-petaled wheel with a central pericarp.
uncertainties: The precise symbolic meaning of rājānam as applied to the cakra is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, eight-petaled, and has a pericarp.
